title: Potential Increase in Makeshift Smoking Corners Due To Phasing Out of Designated Smoking Areas
what_it_is: Potential Increase in Makeshift Smoking Corners Due To Phasing Out of Designated Smoking Areas

sections.label: Smoking corners and makeshift points
sections.summary: Smoking corners in coffee shops are decreasing, and NEA will look into feedback on disamenities from makeshift smoking points and engage stakeholders on mitigating measures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The number of smoking corners in coffee shops has been gradually decreasing over time.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: As mentioned previously in the House, makeshift smoking points are not prohibited unless they are located in places specified in the Smoking (Prohibition in Certain Places) Regulations 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: While NEA does not have plans to conduct any studies or assessments, we will look into feedback on any disamenities caused by makeshift smoking points and, where substantiated, we will engage the relevant stakeholders on possible mitigating measures, including removing or relocating the smoking points.

sections.label: Enforcement and designated smoking areas
sections.summary: Smokers will be fined where prohibited, and NEA will work with premises owners to remove seating and identify designated smoking areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Enforcement will be taken and the smokers will be subjected to fines.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: If the area is not under the prohibition list, technically, it is not illegal to smoke there.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: That is where we would need to work with the premises owners to remove or relocate chairs, seating or receptacles that encourage or make it convenient for smokers to congregate in those areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: NEA will also work with the premises owners to try to identify a potential designated smoking area, which is somewhere where smokers would find convenient or would want to congregate, and at the same time, reduce disamenities to the public.
